note: Frozen VERIFY verdicts + exit codes ONLY (no obligation-report/trust-report/classification fields, the standing A3-churn guard). driver-spec.txt section 15.1 (proved tier) and section 15.2 (asserted tier). Five of the cruxes are defects that actually shipped or behaviour the Python driver still has, not invented mutants; each names its provenance in `why`. TWO REASONS THIS SUITE IS NOT YET WIRED INTO `make refute-crux-gate`: (1) scripts/refute-crux-gate.sh discovers suites under examples/ only; (2) it copies ONE file per case into a temp dir, which breaks shell.llmll and crux-shell-undeclared-authority.llmll, both of which import sibling modules. Wiring needs a whole-directory copy. A third gap is vocabulary: the script knows `safe` and `refuted` only, and a capability violation is neither, so crux-shell-undeclared-authority is recorded as `refuted` because the script greps for `error:`, though it fails at type-check rather than at the solver.
